item.title: Chernobyl's fallout surprises scientists 40 years later
item.description: Forty years after the Chornobyl disaster, tiny radioactive particles remain in the soil. Scientists are using powerful X-rays to study them.

item.title: Exploding stars challenge understanding of the Universe
item.description: An analysis of 2,884 exploding stars has uncovered new evidence about dark energy, the force accelerating the universe's expansion.

item.title: Cambridge scientists develop $10 chip for wrist-worn medical lab
item.description: Cambridge researchers have created a $10 optical sensor that brings laboratory-level precision to a device small enough for the wrist.
